ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two concentric circles, and the center of the circles is labeled C. Horizontal segment AD is a chord of the large circle, and points A and D are on the large circle. Point B is located on chord AD, vertical segment CB is perpendicular from the center C to AD, and there is a right-angle mark in the figure showing CB ⟂ AD. The inner circle is tangent to chord AD at point B, therefore CB is a radius of the inner circle. Segment AC connects from the center C to point A on the large circle, therefore AC is a radius of the large circle. Reasoning: The problem gives AC = 10, so the radius of the large circle R = 10; the length of chord AD is 16. The perpendicular from the center of a circle to a chord bisects the chord, so AB = AD/2 = 8. Triangle ACB is a right triangle, hypotenuse AC = 10, and one leg AB = 8, therefore CB^2 = AC^2 - AB^2 = 10^2 - 8^2 = 100 - 64 = 36. Thus the radius of the inner circle r = CB = 6. The area between the two circles is π(R^2 - r^2) = π(10^2 - 6^2) = π(100 - 36) = 64π.

raw_record.question_text: The two circles pictured have the same center $C$. Chord $\overline{AD}$ is tangent to the inner circle at $B$, $AC$ is $10$, and chord $\overline{AD}$ has length $16$. What is the area between the two circles?

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the large and small circles as concentric at C, with AD drawn as a horizontal chord of the large circle and tangent to the small circle at B; the right-angle marker shows CB is perpendicular to AD. From the text, use AC = 10 as the outer radius and AD = 16 as the full chord length. Since the perpendicular from the center of a circle to a chord bisects the chord, AB = 8. In right triangle ACB, compute CB by the Pythagorean theorem: CB^2 = AC^2 - AB^2 = 10^2 - 8^2 = 36, so CB is the inner radius. Then the desired area between circles is pi(10^2 - CB^2) = pi(100 - 36) = 64pi.

推理：题目给出 AC = 10，所以大圆半径 R = 10；弦 AD 的长度是 16。圆心到弦的垂线会平分弦，所以 AB = AD/2 = 8。三角形 ACB 是直角三角形，斜边 AC = 10，一条直角边 AB = 8，因此 CB^2 = AC^2 - AB^2 = 10^2 - 8^2 = 100 - 64 = 36。于是内圆半径 r = CB = 6。两圆之间的面积为 π(R^2 - r^2) = π(10^2 - 6^2) = π(100 - 36) = 64π。

claims.source: The area between the two circles is π(R^2 - r^2) = π(10^2 - 6^2) = π(100 - 36) = 64π.
